_comment: Limits for the ci-scale run in CI (scripts/perf/run.mjs --scale=ci --runs=3). Timings are medians in ms on a GitHub-hosted runner. Lower a limit when a change makes a number better; raise one only with a reason in the pull request.
_fork: easelyte fork: the bundle limits sit above upstream's (304/858 KB) because the fork ships extra features (turn cards, subagent view, Ops pane, Files viewer). They are the measured size plus about 5%. On an upstream sync keep these two numbers (take upstream's for every other metric); a conflict here is expected, not an error.
